name: HH regime-switch 07 — realized-vol CONTRACTION reversion, tight-band via bb_width (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM (distinct from variant 06: it identifies the contraction regime by a SQUEEZED Bollinger band — bb_width below a fitted ceiling, the literal low-volatility geometry — instead of realized vol, reads over-extension with bb_z alone (no RSI), and runs on 1h to trade the faster oscillation a quiet tape produces): in a genuine volatility squeeze the band is narrow and price ping-pongs around the mean; buying the lower edge of a narrow band and selling back to the mean harvests the market-maker's inventory rebalancing. Using bb_width as the regime detector is the honest low-vol read — a narrow band IS contraction. Exit: bb_z reverts to the mean or bb_width expands (squeeze breaks — the regime flipped, stop fading), or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: the reversion edge inside the tight-band regime must clear the Gate net of fees at 1h; if bb_width and variant 06's vol_realized select the same bars (their trades overlap and net Sharpes match), they are one spec — collapse them. Kill if a squeeze-break (band expanding while short) causes a >20% adverse-excursion tail — that is fading into a real move, not a mean.
catalyst: Bollinger squeeze with price at the lower band — a quiet-tape mean to fade
